title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZJ (Issue of bonus shares)

content.overview: A Producer Company may issue bonus shares on the Board's recommendation and by resolution in a general meeting, by capitalizing amounts from the general reserves referred to in section 378ZI. The bonus shares must be issued in proportion to the shares held by Members on the date of issue.
content.glance: Bonus shares require Board recommendation, a general-meeting resolution, capitalization of the specified general reserves, and proportional allocation based on holdings on the issue date.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZJ (Issue of bonus shares). A Producer Company may issue bonus shares on the Board's recommendation and after a resolution is passed in a general meeting. The issue is by capitalization of amounts from the general reserves referred to in section 378ZI and must be in proportion to the shares held by Members on the date of issue. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Board recommendation and Member resolution
sections.body: A Producer Company may issue bonus shares upon recommendation of the Board and passing of a resolution in a general meeting.

sections.heading: Source of capitalization
sections.body: The bonus shares are issued by capitalization of amounts from the general reserves referred to in section 378ZI.

sections.heading: Proportional allocation
sections.body: Bonus shares must be issued in proportion to the shares held by Members on the date of issue.

examples.title: Checking a proposed bonus issue
examples.body: Verify the Board's recommendation, the general-meeting resolution, the source of capitalization under section 378ZI, and the Member shareholdings on the issue date used for proportional allocation.

hypotheticals.question: A Producer Company proposes to issue bonus shares but plans to allocate them in a ratio different from Members' holdings on the issue date. What does section 378ZJ require?
hypotheticals.analysis: Check the Board recommendation and general-meeting resolution, verify that the amounts are capitalized from the general reserves referred to in section 378ZI, and compare the proposed allocation with Members' shareholdings on the date of issue.

distinctions.title: Bonus shares and cash distribution
distinctions.left: Section 378ZJ concerns bonus shares issued by capitalization of specified general reserves in proportion to Members' shareholdings.
distinctions.right: A cash distribution is not the bonus-share mechanism described in section 378ZJ.

rows.right: Payment of money rather than issue of bonus shares

rows.left: Proportionate to shares held on the issue date
rows.right: Not the allocation rule stated in section 378ZJ

misconceptions.trap: Treating a Board recommendation alone as sufficient to issue bonus shares.
misconceptions.correction: Section 378ZJ also requires a resolution in a general meeting.

misconceptions.trap: Using a source of funds other than the general reserves referred to in section 378ZI.
misconceptions.correction: Check that the capitalization comes from the reserves identified by the section.

misconceptions.trap: Allocating bonus shares without reference to Members' holdings on the date of issue.
misconceptions.correction: The section requires proportionality to the shares held by Members on the issue date.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378zj do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: A Producer Company may issue bonus shares by capitalising reserves, in the manner and subject to the conditions the section states.
